services.desc: Our professional staff has decades of combined service in the hospitality industry and will make sure your event is unforgettable and effortless. Whether you’re organizing a 10-person business meeting or a 500-person reception, our catering staff and event managers have one goal in mind - to create a custom-designed event to meet your desires and needs. Each of our ten staterooms and reception areas feature floor-to-ceiling windows offering the most stunning views of Birmingham, and most of the rooms have direct access to one of our soaring patios.
